threshold_source: Existing production controls plus the direct winding optimizer energy variance and known-sector ED gates. The demonstrated cold plateau requires separating legacy sweep/bond heuristics from stationarity; no tolerance has been relaxed.
null_gate_meaning: Required evidence is missing; unknown does not pass.
